note: Description-level routing rubrics. The validator checks structure and skill names; it does not run a model.

cases.prompt: Resume yesterday's half-finished migration. The earlier session's file excerpts and test results are in the transcript.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: reasoning from the old test result
expected_completion_evidence: checkpoint with current evidence and next action

cases.prompt: Rename one variable in the file you just read.
expected_completion_evidence: the renamed variable

cases.prompt: The context window is nearly full halfway through a refactor with two failing tests.
expected_initial_tools: checkpoint of goal, failures and changed files
expected_completion_evidence: failure signatures preserved across compaction

cases.prompt: Explain the release protocol in docs/RELEASE.md; the repository and path are known.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: repository-wide search for the known file
expected_completion_evidence: the relevant protocol excerpt

cases.prompt: In an unfamiliar repository, find where request rate limiting is implemented and which test covers it.
expected_completion_evidence: owning file paths and the covering test command

cases.prompt: In this multi-repository workspace, find which checkout owns the release tooling and which shared instructions apply.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: searching contents of every checkout before selecting an owner
expected_completion_evidence: owning checkout, instruction paths and a search scoped to that checkout

cases.prompt: The owner repository is known, but default rg found no matches. Locate the setting under its hidden .config directory without searching generated dependencies.
expected_initial_tools: scoped hidden-file search excluding .git and caches
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: treating default rg absence as proof
expected_completion_evidence: source path and relevant lines, with search coverage stated

cases.prompt: Count enabled entries by kind in two supplied JSON files. Python is already available in the selected environment; show only counts and source names.
expected_initial_tools: standard-library JSON projection of the supplied files
expected_completion_evidence: counts grouped by kind and input paths

cases.prompt: Explain the policy excerpt that was already quoted earlier in this conversation.
expected_completion_evidence: an explanation grounded in the excerpt

cases.prompt: Find every caller of parse_config and migrate them after changing its signature.
expected_initial_tools: code index callers or literal search
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: leaving a compatibility shim without a consumer
expected_completion_evidence: all callers migrated and checked

cases.prompt: `ast-index search --query Config` failed with "unexpected argument '--query' found".
expected_completion_evidence: exact working invocation and exit status

cases.prompt: The code_explore MCP tool vanished from the tool list; its server log shows connection refused on the socket.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: direct socket access to bypass the server
expected_completion_evidence: failure class and enforcing layer

cases.prompt: The parser unit test fails with an assertion error on empty input.
expected_initial_tools: read the failing test and parser
expected_completion_evidence: fixed parser with the test passing

cases.prompt: A sandboxed git push is rejected with EPERM while local commits work.
expected_completion_evidence: which authority is missing and how to grant it

cases.prompt: Inspect the profile selection and explain which skills are currently installed. Do not change any files.
expected_initial_tools: read the profile and selected skill sources
expected_completion_evidence: source-backed inventory with unexercised runtime behavior identified

cases.prompt: Review an external migration plan against its cited sources and acceptance criteria without changing repository code.
expected_initial_tools: read the plan and its factual sources
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: running a repository code gate for the external document
expected_completion_evidence: review of sources, assumptions and acceptance criteria

cases.prompt: Which checks should run after changing the CLI argument parser?
expected_initial_tools: declared check commands in README, justfile or CI
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: full VM test suite without request
expected_completion_evidence: fast gate plus one focused CLI invocation

cases.prompt: All tests pass but the reported bug still reproduces in the real app; the tests mock the HTTP client.
expected_initial_tools: trace one assertion through its mock
expected_completion_evidence: a test that fails on the bug

cases.prompt: Write the changelog entry for the 2.1 release.
expected_completion_evidence: changelog entry

cases.prompt: Add a regression test for the off-by-one bug and verify the fix.
expected_initial_tools: show the new test failing without the fix
expected_completion_evidence: test fails before and passes after the fix

cases.prompt: Simplify the duplicated retry helpers in client.py and server.py without changing behavior.
expected_initial_tools: read both helpers and their callers
expected_completion_evidence: one shared helper, callers migrated, checks pass

cases.prompt: Train a reward model that scores code quality.
expected_completion_evidence: a training plan

cases.prompt: Refactor the authentication middleware and remove the legacy token path.
expected_initial_tools: identify consumers of the legacy path
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: removing a path with an identified consumer
expected_completion_evidence: negative auth tests pass

cases.prompt: The feature is implemented. Wrap it up: review, verify and commit it.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: ending with a prose claim instead of a read-back
expected_completion_evidence: git log -1 read-back after the commit

cases.prompt: Push the already reviewed commit on branch fix/timeout and open a merge request against main.
expected_completion_evidence: remote ref and merge request identity

cases.prompt: Show me the last five commits on this branch.
expected_completion_evidence: the five commits

cases.prompt: Finish this change and push it to the default branch.
expected_initial_tools: review of the full change set
expected_completion_evidence: read-back of the pushed ref

cases.prompt: The dev server hangs at 100% CPU and port 3000 stays in use after Ctrl+C.
expected_completion_evidence: process state and confirmed cause

cases.prompt: This install script works on Ubuntu but fails on macOS with "sed: 1: invalid command code".
expected_completion_evidence: portable in-place edit and the tested shells

cases.prompt: Write a Python function that parses ISO-8601 dates.
expected_completion_evidence: function with tests

cases.prompt: A cron-run shell script leaves zombie child processes on both Linux and macOS.
expected_initial_tools: ps state of the children and their parent
expected_completion_evidence: children reaped on both systems

cases.prompt: In zsh, `for f in $files; do wc -l $f; done` treats all names as one argument.
expected_initial_tools: rewrite with an explicit list or array
expected_completion_evidence: loop output in zsh and bash

cases.prompt: A script with #!/bin/bash fails with "bad interpreter: No such file or directory" on a NixOS machine.
expected_completion_evidence: portable shebang and a successful run

cases.prompt: Write a Dockerfile for the Node.js app.
expected_completion_evidence: Dockerfile

cases.prompt: Make the deploy script run on both Ubuntu and macOS CI runners and prove it.
expected_initial_tools: find GNU-only flags in the script
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: claiming macOS support without a macOS run
expected_completion_evidence: passing runs on both runners, or the untested target named

cases.prompt: Give the deployment service an API token so it can call the billing API.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: token in source, derivation or process arguments
expected_completion_evidence: negative test for a missing token

cases.prompt: Prepare this private repository for publication on GitHub.
expected_initial_tools: secret scan of tree and history
expected_completion_evidence: coverage and findings report

cases.prompt: Fix the CSS alignment of the footer.
expected_completion_evidence: aligned footer

cases.prompt: The agent sandbox blocks access to the package registry; should the egress allowlist be widened?
expected_completion_evidence: narrowest proposed allowlist change

cases.prompt: Help me turn my idea for faster repository search into a clear agent goal. Do not implement it yet.
expected_initial_tools: use existing context and inspect relevant project evidence
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: inventing a model or token budget
expected_completion_evidence: self-contained goal with outcome, context, work, boundaries and observable acceptance criteria

cases.prompt: Execute the goal we defined above. Its scope and acceptance criteria are unchanged.
expected_initial_tools: read the agreed goal and current relevant source
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: asking for the same execution confirmation again
expected_completion_evidence: results checked against acceptance criteria, with evidence and any remaining blockers

cases.prompt: Define a goal for the login retry bug described above and then implement it, including the regression check.
expected_initial_tools: use the bug evidence to state a bounded goal
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: stopping after definition to ask for an already authorized start
expected_completion_evidence: goal followed by implementation and regression-check evidence

cases.prompt: The goal wording looks good. We could work on this later.
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: treating wording approval as authorization to implement
expected_completion_evidence: goal remains ready for a later explicit execution request

cases.prompt: Execute this goal with a hard 20000-token cap. This session exposes no token-budget enforcement control.
expected_initial_tools: verify available runtime controls without beginning goal implementation
unavailable_or_forbidden_tools: claiming the prompt enforces the cap
silently treating the hard cap as a guideline
expected_completion_evidence: unsupported requirement explained and a supported setting or relaxed requirement requested before execution

cases.prompt: Fix the typo in the button label in the file we just inspected.
expected_completion_evidence: corrected label
